package mutation

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

var queueDiagnosticScans, queueDiagnosticReads atomic.Uint64

// Compiled only through the benchmark driver's overlay.
func TestQueueCostDiagnostic(t *testing.T) {
	param := func(key string) int {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv(key))
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", key, err)
		}
		return n
	}
	holders, waiters := param("RX_QUEUE_HOLDERS"), param("RX_QUEUE_WAITERS")
	root, state := t.TempDir(), t.TempDir()
	c, err := New(root, state, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := range holders {
		lease, err := c.Acquire(t.Context(), Intent{Effect: NamedPaths, Paths: []string{filepath.Join(root, fmt.Sprint(i))}})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer lease.End(NotExecuted)
	}
	notices := make(chan struct{}, waiters)
	w, err := New(root, state, func(n Notice) {
		if n.State == "waiting" {
			notices <- struct{}{}
		}
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	type result struct {
		at  time.Time
		err error
	}
	done := make(chan result, waiters)
	start := time.Now()
	for range waiters {
		go func() {
			lease, err := w.Acquire(ctx, Intent{Effect: NamedPaths, Paths: []string{filepath.Join(root, "0")}})
			if lease != nil {
				lease.End(NotExecuted)
			}
			done <- result{time.Now(), err}
		}()
	}
	for range waiters {
		select {
		case <-notices:
		case <-t.Context().Done():
			t.Fatal(t.Context().Err())
		}
	}
	queueReady := time.Since(start)
	// A fixed observation interval measures the current 20ms poll protocol.
	startScans, startReads := queueDiagnosticScans.Load(), queueDiagnosticReads.Load()
	observeStart := time.Now()
	time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
	observeElapsed := time.Since(observeStart)
	scans, reads := queueDiagnosticScans.Load()-startScans, queueDiagnosticReads.Load()-startReads
	cancelAt := time.Now()
	cancel()
	var cleanup []float64
	for range waiters {
		r := <-done
		if !errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("waiting request was not cancelled: %v", r.err)
		}
		cleanup = append(cleanup, float64(r.at.Sub(cancelAt))/float64(time.Millisecond))
	}
	slices.Sort(cleanup)
	quantile := func(p int) float64 {
		if len(cleanup) == 0 {
			return 0
		}
		return cleanup[(len(cleanup)*p+99)/100-1]
	}
	metrics := map[string]any{"holders": holders, "waiters": waiters,
		"queue_ready_ms": float64(queueReady)/float64(time.Millisecond),
		"observe_ms": 300, "actual_observe_ms": float64(observeElapsed)/float64(time.Millisecond), "registry_scans": scans, "record_reads": reads, "cancel_p50_ms": quantile(50), "cancel_p95_ms": quantile(95)}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(metrics)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("RX_QUEUE_METRICS %s\n", raw)
}
